name: io.github.dikaglorya/telegram-mcp
title: Telegram MCP
description: Local MCP server connecting AI agents to a personal Telegram account over MTProto. Full account access with access profiles, human approval gate, localhost dashboard, MCP prompts/resources, and workflow tools.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ACCESS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Access profile: readonly | messaging | moderator | full (default: full)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_APPROVAL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Approval mode: off | destructive | writes (default: off)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_APPROVAL_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a pending approval lives (default: 600, range: 30-86400)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOW_ALL_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Full access to every chat the account can reach (default: true)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist: @name, numeric id, or exact title

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: State directory for session, approvals, audit, downloads, exports (default: ~/.telegram-mcp)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap for one download in bytes, 0 = unlimited (default: 0)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_DASHBOARD_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the localhost dashboard (default: random)

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_DASHBOARD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fixed token for the dashboard (min 16 chars, default: random)
